notable_absence.finding: As on the Capella twin: the page instructs readers to 'refrain from editing an exported file before importing the file back to the Couchbase cluster' but documents no import UI flow or validation step anywhere - the import half of the round-trip is asserted, not shown.

cross_component_finding: The sample export JSON's field names (dcp_stream_boundary, deadline_timeout, execution_timeout, language_compatibility, log_level, n1ql_consistency, worker_count, using_timer, src_mutation, depcfg.buckets/curl/metadata_bucket/source_bucket) are the actual internal/wire names behind the UI display labels this batch's other pages only ever show by their display names (Deployment Feed Boundary, OnDeploy/Script Timeout, Language Compatibility, Workers, SQL++ Consistency) - this export sample is one of the only places in the batch where the mapping between a UI label and its internal field name is directly visible rather than asserted in prose.
cross_product_finding: This page and its Capella twin (cloud/eventing/eventing-function-export.md) are byte-identical apart from frontmatter - confirmed by direct diff. Round 8's own extraction of the Capella twin flagged this as an isolated anomaly ('Couchbase Server (self-managed) terminology bleeding into a page filed under cloud/eventing/... authored for/copied from the self-managed Server product without adaptation'), treating it as a one-off finding about that page. Read from this side, the more complete picture is that THIS page is the unmodified source: its 'Access the Couchbase Web Console > Eventing page' instructions and its sample JSON (including the literal internal build-version string 'evt-6.5.0-4960-ee') are entirely native and correct here, and the Capella tree carries an unedited copy of them. This is the same content-sharing mechanism behind every byte-identical pair this round has found elsewhere in the batch, just caught here from the angle that shows the copy is functionally wrong on the receiving side (Capella's UI is not the Couchbase Web Console) rather than merely incomplete.
